name: io.github.Akkiruk/craftos-mcp
title: craftos-mcp
description: CC:Tweaked (ComputerCraft) emulator: run, test and screenshot Lua programs, monitors and turtles.

environmentVariables.name: CRAFTOS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Folder with your Lua project, copied onto every emulated computer (default: the current folder).

environmentVariables.name: CRAFTOS_ADDONS
environmentVariables.description: Mods to simulate besides CC:Tweaked: all, none, or ids separated by commas such as create,mekanism.

environmentVariables.name: CRAFTOS_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Minecraft version new computers start on: 1.21.1 (CC:Tweaked 1.121.0, the default), 1.20.1 (CC:Tweaked 1.121.0) or 1.18.2 (CC:Tweaked 1.101.3).
